proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly identifies Punjabi rassī as the source of the widespread Hindi/Bihari rassī/rasrī and Awadhi rasarī rope family. These Bagheli forms are treated as contact forms; the existing Hindi rassī node is used as a provisional nearby donor proxy, preserving its Punjabi ancestry. The exact regional path of transmission and the local expanded vowels remain uncertain.
